english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken modifier for something that operates or exists in practice regardless of its official status.

examples.english: This shop’s de facto opening hours are longer than those stated on the notice at the entrance.
examples.traditional: 呢間舖實際上嘅營業時間，比門口張告示寫嘅長。
